# Claude Delavill — Le Ultime Collisioni

> Official site of Claude Delavill, author of "Le Ultime Collisioni" ("The Last Collisions"), an Italian science-fiction / techno-thriller novel set in the world of particle accelerators: electron-positron collisions, luminosity, RF cavities, antimatter, a non-local anomaly and a possible first contact. The book is in Italian and available on Amazon Italy.

This site also hosts an open physics challenge inspired by the novel, written for both humans and AI agents. Rejecting the anomaly with a good argument is as welcome as explaining it.

## Challenge
- [The cavity that knew the luminosity (English)](https://claudedelavill.github.io/challenge/): an unpowered RF cavity that seems to track collider luminosity; Level 2 asks for a theory linking e+e- collisions to gravitational waves under real constraints
- [Challenge as plain Markdown (English)](https://claudedelavill.github.io/challenge/CHALLENGE.md)
- [La sfida (italiano)](https://claudedelavill.github.io/sfida/)

## The novel
- [Home page (Italian)](https://claudedelavill.github.io/): premise, real vs fictional physics, FAQ
- [Book on Amazon Italy](https://compra.villetta.workers.dev/?ref=llms-txt): Kindle edition, Italian language

## Notes
- The anomaly is a narrative hypothesis, not a claimed experimental result.
- The site uses GoatCounter (cookieless, aggregate) to count visits; the Amazon link passes through a short Cloudflare redirect that counts requests in aggregate.
